insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured + Booster+ Sum Insured + Safeguard/Safeguard+ Sum Insured (as per plan/Policy Schedule)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: “We don’t limit your choice. Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.”
great.explanation: You can choose any room without a limit on room rent, which helps avoid proportionate deductions and protects your Sum Insured.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: “ReAssure “Forever”: Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured. The first paid claim in the life of the policy triggers ReAssure “Forever”. Once Triggered it stays for life, provided that the policy is renewed without break.”
great.explanation: After your first paid claim, an unlimited Sum Insured buffer activates for life if you renew continuously, providing strong long-term claim protection.

great.name: Consumables
great.quote: “Claim Safeguard: We will cover non-payable items mentioned in ‘List I – Expenses not covered’ of Annexure I’.”
great.explanation: Non-payable consumables like gloves and masks are covered if you choose Safeguard or Safeguard+, reducing out-of-pocket expenses.

great.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
great.explanation: Expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered, which helps with extended recovery costs.

great.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
great.quote: “Home Care Treatment means treatment availed by the insured person at home which in normal course would require care and treatment at a hospital but is actually taken at home...”
great.explanation: Treatment received at home that normally requires hospital care is covered, providing flexibility and convenience.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: “...excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.”
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months, which is a common and acceptable waiting period.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: “...excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...”
good.explanation: Specified illnesses and procedures have a 24-month waiting period, which is standard in the market.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded...”
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days, while accidents are typically covered immediately, which is standard practice.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: “...for 60 days before the date of admission...”
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered, which is a good standard benefit.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: “Air Ambulance: Only in case of Emergency. Maximum INR 2,50,000 per hospitalization.”
good.explanation: Emergency air ambulance transport is covered up to ₹2,50,000 per hospitalization, adding valuable support in critical cases.

good.name: Modern Treatments
good.quote: “We pay for Modern treatments as specified below: 1. Uterine Artery Embolization and HIFU... 7. Robotic surgeries ...”
good.explanation: Coverage includes a specified list of modern treatments, ensuring access to advanced procedures with some limits.

good.name: Room Type
good.quote: “Room Type Modification... You can choose between a Single Private Room and a Sharing Room.”
good.explanation: You can select between single private or sharing rooms, offering flexibility for pricing and comfort.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.explanation: There is no clause to restore or replenish Sum Insured after a claim, so your coverage does not reset post-claim.

bad.name: No Claim Bonus
bad.explanation: No explicit No Claim Bonus or renewal increment is provided, so your Sum Insured does not increase on claim-free renewals.

bad.name: Cashless Network
bad.quote: “Cashless claim facility is available at our network hospitals ONLY... for the latest list, refer to our website www.nivabupa.com.”
bad.explanation: The number of network hospitals is not stated, so it is unclear if the cashless network size meets market standards.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: “Co-Payment: It is the percentage of admissible claim amount You would have to bear, Rest we will pay.”
bad.explanation: Co-payment is mentioned but the exact percentage and applicability are not specified, so its impact is unclear.

unclear.name: Deductible
unclear.quote: “This is an aggregate amount in a year... which we will NOT pay. Once the total expense exceeds this amount, balance we will pay.”
unclear.explanation: A deductible feature exists but the rupee amount is not stated, so the financial impact cannot be determined.

unclear.name: Safeguard Option
unclear.quote: “Sum Insured will be utilized as per following sequence... 3. Safeguard/Safeguard+ Sum Insured” and “You can either choose Safeguard or Safeguard+ at a given point in time.”
unclear.reference: Section 3 (Sum Insured sequence) and Section 4.17 Note
unclear.explanation: Safeguard/Safeguard+ coverage is selectable but it is unclear if it is included by default or only if opted for.

unclear.name: Booster+ Cap
unclear.quote: “Maximum it will accumulate up to 3/5/10 times (based on the plan you have chosen) of the Base Sum Insured.”
unclear.explanation: Booster+ accumulation limits vary by plan variant, so the exact multiplier depends on your chosen plan.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
